title: Completed scalar extension is exact
statement: For a prime l, finite l-adic coefficient extension E to F, and any scheme W, ordinary extension of module sheaves along completedCoefficientMap preserves finite limits and finite colimits. No completeness condition on the module is imposed.

source.place: Tag 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), Tag 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change); ordinary tensor associativity: sites-modules.tex, Tag 03EK.

proof.text: Constant extension is exact by baseTensor_exact, and constant restriction is exact. The ordinary balancing identifies their composite with completed extension followed by restriction. Underlying abelian sheaves are unchanged by restriction, and the functor to abelian sheaves reflects finite limits and colimits. Transport preservation across the balancing isomorphism, then reflect it to completed extension.
